The data dictionary lists the data each journey records or exchanges, as the [WHO SMART Guidelines DAK](https://smart.who.int/ig-starter-kit/l2_dak.html) does in its component 5: one data set per step that writes or reads it, each a FHIR logical model whose elements carry a code (`TD.<data set>.DE<nn>`, CodeSystem [TrustDemoDataElements](CodeSystem-TrustDemoDataElements.html)), a definition, a cardinality and, where the guide has a code list, a binding. Each model's mapping `realisation` says where this guide realises the element: in a profile or example, in the DVC payload of WHO SMART Trust PHW (`DVCMinPreQual`), or in a CWT or COSE field. The data elements are read by the [decision-support logic](decision-logic.html) and counted by the [indicators](indicators.html).

The source is `dak/data-dictionary.json`; the guide's logical models, code lists and this page are generated from it. Every person and value in the examples is fictional.

### TD.J1 Birth-dose DVC

What the birth hospital records for each birth dose and signs into one Digital Vaccination Certificate (DVC, an HCERT) per dose: the payload, the CWT claims and the key that signs it.

- **Logical model:** [TrustDemoDdBirthDoseDvc](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdBirthDoseDvc.html)
- **Recorded or read in:** [J1 Issue the newborn's birth-dose DVCs in Country A](business-processes.html#j1-issue-the-newborns-birth-dose-dvcs-in-country-a): Build one DVCMinPreQual payload per dose (`Task_Payload`); Prepare: CWT claims and the COSE Sig_structure (`Task_Prepare`); Sign the bytes with XXR's DSC key (`Task_Sign`)
- **Requirements:** [STT-PAY-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-001), [STT-PAY-002](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-002), [STT-PAY-003](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-003), [STT-PAY-005](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-005), [STT-CWT-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-cwt-001)

| TD.J3B.DE05 | `countsTowardSchedule` | Counts toward the schedule | 1..1 | boolean | Whether the schedule counts the dose (decision table TD.DT.03): only doses from a primary source with a national schedule code. |  | ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.supportingImmunization |
| TD.J3B.DE06 | `dueDose` | Dose due | 0..* | BackboneElement | A dose of the national schedule the evaluation finds due (decision table TD.DT.04). |  | ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation, as TrustDemoJ3Recommendation |
| TD.J3B.DE07 | `dueDose.scheduleCode` | Schedule dose | 1..1 | Coding | The schedule's antigen-and-dose code of the dose due. | [TrustDemoLaoEpiScheduleCodes](ValueSet-TrustDemoLaoEpiScheduleCodes.html) (required) | ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.vaccineCode |
| TD.J3B.DE08 | `dueDose.forecast` | Forecast status | 1..1 | code | The forecast for the dose. | <http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/immunization-recommendation-status> (example) | ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.forecastStatus |
| TD.J3B.DE09 | `dueDose.dueDate` | Due date | 1..1 | date | The child's date of birth plus the schedule action's timing age. |  | ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.dateCriterion (LOINC 30980-7) |
| TD.J3B.DE10 | `reminder` | Reminder | 0..1 | Reference(Task) | The reminder created for the next visit. |  | Task, as TrustDemoJ3Reminder |
{: .grid }

### TD.J40 Shared link and consent

What the home country records when the holder shares a family member's summary as a Verifiable Health Link (VHL): who may read what, for how long, and that a passcode protects it.

- **Logical model:** [TrustDemoDdVhlShare](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdVhlShare.html)
- **Recorded or read in:** [J4.0 Issue the family's records to one phone as VHLs](business-processes.html#j40-issue-the-familys-records-to-one-phone-as-vhls): Assemble each member's IPS and DVCs (`Task_Assemble`); Encrypt the documents and publish a passcode-protected manifest (`Task_Share`)
- **Requirements:** [STD-ACC-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-acc-001.json)
- **Realised by:** [Consent TrustDemoJ4Consent](Consent-TrustDemoJ4Consent.html), [Bundle TrustDemoJ4Ips](Bundle-TrustDemoJ4Ips.html)

| Code | Element | Label | Card. | Type | Definition | Binding | Realised in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TD.J40.DE01 | `subject` | Subject | 1..1 | Reference(Patient) | The family member whose summary is shared. |  | Consent.subject |
| TD.J40.DE02 | `holder` | Holder | 1..1 | Reference(RelatedPerson) | The person who shares the link and decides who may open it. |  | Consent.grantor |
| TD.J40.DE03 | `custodian` | Custodian | 1..1 | Reference(Organization) | The home-country service that hosts the record and checks every request. |  | Consent.controller |
| TD.J40.DE04 | `sharedDocument` | Shared document | 1..1 | Reference(Bundle) | The patient summary the link releases. |  | Consent.provision.data.reference |
| TD.J40.DE05 | `validFrom` | Valid from | 1..1 | date | The first day the link may be opened. |  | Consent.provision.period.start |
| TD.J40.DE06 | `validUntil` | Valid until | 1..1 | date | The expiry the holder chose; after it the link releases nothing ([STD-ACC-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-acc-001.json)). |  | Consent.provision.period.end |
| TD.J40.DE07 | `purpose` | Purpose | 1..1 | Coding | The purpose of use the holder allows (J4: treatment). |  | Consent.provision.purpose |
| TD.J40.DE08 | `passcodeSet` | Passcode set | 1..1 | boolean | Whether the holder protected the link with a passcode. The passcode itself is never stored in the record. |  | the link's passcode flag (IHE ITI VHL); not in Consent |
| TD.J40.DE09 | `withdrawnAt` | Withdrawn at | 0..1 | dateTime | When the holder withdrew the link, if they did. |  | Consent.status = inactive; not yet realised in the examples |
{: .grid }

### TD.J41 Access to a shared link

What the home country logs for every request to open a shared link, released or refused.

- **Logical model:** [TrustDemoDdVhlAccess](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdVhlAccess.html)
- **Recorded or read in:** [J4.1 Read a family member's records at the point of care abroad](business-processes.html#j41-read-a-family-members-records-at-the-point-of-care-abroad): Request the manifest (ITI-YY5), signed (`Task_Fetch`); Check the passcode, return the manifest and log the access (`Task_Release`)
- **Requirements:** [STD-ACC-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-acc-001.json), [STT-VHL-005](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-vhl-005)
- **Realised by:** [StructureDefinition TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess.html), [AuditEvent TrustDemoJ41Access](AuditEvent-TrustDemoJ41Access.html), [AuditEvent TrustDemoJ41WrongPasscode](AuditEvent-TrustDemoJ41WrongPasscode.html)

| Code | Element | Label | Card. | Type | Definition | Binding | Realised in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TD.J41.DE01 | `requestedAt` | Requested at | 1..1 | dateTime | When the request arrived. |  | TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess: AuditEvent.recorded |
| TD.J41.DE02 | `requester` | Requester | 1..1 | Reference(Device) | The receiving system abroad that asked for the manifest. |  | TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess: AuditEvent.agent (IRCP).who |
| TD.J41.DE03 | `requesterAddress` | Requester network address | 0..1 | string | Where the request came from. |  | TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess: AuditEvent.agent.networkString |
| TD.J41.DE04 | `custodian` | Custodian | 1..1 | Reference(Device) | The home-country gateway that answered and logged the request. |  | TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess: AuditEvent.agent (CST).who; TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess: AuditEvent.source.observer |
| TD.J41.DE05 | `patient` | Patient | 1..1 | Reference(Patient) | Whose record was asked for. |  | TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess: AuditEvent.entity (role Patient) |
| TD.J41.DE06 | `released` | Released | 1..1 | boolean | Whether the manifest was released (decision table TD.DT.05). |  | TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess: AuditEvent.outcome.code |
| TD.J41.DE07 | `outcome` | Audit outcome | 1..1 | code | 0 when released; 4 (minor failure) when refused. | <http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/audit-event-outcome> (preferred) | TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess: AuditEvent.outcome.code |
| TD.J41.DE08 | `refusalReason` | Refusal reason | 0..1 | code | Why nothing was released, when refused. | [TrustDemoVhlRefusalReasonVS](ValueSet-TrustDemoVhlRefusalReasonVS.html) (required) | TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess: AuditEvent.outcome.detail |
| TD.J41.DE09 | `consent` | Consent | 0..1 | Reference(Consent) | The holder's consent the request was checked against. |  | TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess: AuditEvent.entity |
| TD.J41.DE10 | `document` | Document released | 0..1 | Reference(Bundle) | The summary released, when released. |  | TrustDemoLaoVhlAccess: AuditEvent.entity |
{: .grid }

### Code lists

The code lists the data elements bind to, beside the vaccine code systems of the examples ([TrustDemoVaccineProducts](ValueSet-TrustDemoVaccineProducts.html), [TrustDemoLaoEpiScheduleCodes](ValueSet-TrustDemoLaoEpiScheduleCodes.html)) and FHIR's own.

| Code list | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [Result of reading a DVC](CodeSystem-TrustDemoVerificationResult.html) | `verified`, `failed`, `unverified` | What the HCERT library returns for one scanned DVC: a verified result, a failed result naming the step and reason ([STT-VER-008](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-008)), or the distinct result of the unverified triage read ([STT-VER-011](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-011)). |
| [Verification steps](CodeSystem-TrustDemoVerificationStep.html) | `prefix`, `base45`, `inflate`, `cose`, `header`, `trust-lookup`, `signature`, `key-usage`, `cwt`, `time`, `hcert`, `payload` | The steps of DVC verification in the order they run ([STT-VER-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-001)), as the HCERT library names them in its typed result ([STT-VER-008](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-008)). |
| [Verification failure reasons](CodeSystem-TrustDemoVerificationFailureReason.html) | `BadPrefix`, `UnsupportedContextVersion`, `Base45Invalid`, `InflateFailed`, `LimitExceeded`, `CoseMalformed`, `HeaderInvalid`, `UnsupportedAlgorithm`, `KidNotFound`, `SignatureInvalid`, `KeyUsageMismatch`, `Expired`, `NotYetValid`, `HcertMissing`, `MultipleSubclaims`, `PayloadInvalid` | The closed set of reasons a DVC fails verification, shared by the Kotlin and Rust HCERT libraries ([STT-VER-008](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-008)). |
| [What a scanned DVC becomes in the record](CodeSystem-TrustDemoDvcOutcome.html) | `verified`, `reported-unverified`, `rejected`, `not-read` | The outcome of decision table TD.DT.01 for one scanned DVC. |
| [How an imported dose got its national schedule code](CodeSystem-TrustDemoCodeMappingBasis.html) | `concept-map`, `clinician-confirmed`, `unmapped`, `not-imported` | The outcome of decision table TD.DT.02 ([STD-SEM-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-sem-001.json)). |
| [Why a shared link released nothing](CodeSystem-TrustDemoVhlRefusalReason.html) | `withdrawn`, `expired`, `wrong-passcode` | The refusal reasons of decision table TD.DT.05 ([STD-ACC-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-acc-001.json)). |
{: .grid }
